newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT- GOLDMAN SACHS GLOBAL PRIORITY LIST.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- GOLDMAN SACHS GLOBAL PRIORITY LIST.

text.p: Goldman Sachs launched its inaugural global priority list on Wednesday, comprising 30 stocks which the company said represent the strongest investment ideas from the 2,000 shares it covers worldwide.
"The performance target for the stocks is for them to provide absolute returns of 20 percent over a 12 to 18 month period," Goldman Sachs said in a statement.
It said the list was not fixed but would not significantly increase in size.
The list comprises the following stocks:
EUROPE -- BassPlc , BAT Industries , Ericsson , HSBC Holdings Plc , Novartis AG , Roche Holding AG , Sema , Unilever Plc , VEBA AG , Zurich Insurance .

U.S. -- AFLAC Inc , AlliedSignal Inc , Cadence Design Systems Inc , Citicorp , ElPaso Energy Corp , Fluor Corp , IntelCorp , MBNA Corp , MGIC Investment Corp , Philip Morris Cos Inc , Safeway Inc , The Estee Lauder Cos .
JAPAN -- Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) , Sony Corp , Sumitomo Electric Inds .
ASIA -- Hutchison Whampoa , National Mutual Asia , PTT Exploration and Production , United Overseas Bank .
